bracken_rescue.name: Bracken
bracken_rescue.greeting: A black hound braces against a strap caught in the roadside roots. Beside him lies a travelling harness with its owner's name worn away.
lines: Kael: Easy. Pulling only tightens it. I'll stay here a moment.
He watches the open hand, then lets the strap slacken. This is an ordinary frightened animal, not the thing haunting Toma's fold.

actions.label: Kneel nearby and let him settle.

variants.greeting: Bracken lifts his head at Kael's step.
lines: Kael: There you are.

actions.label: Offer your hand.
Share one travel bread.
Rest beside him a moment.

variants.greeting: The hound has stayed on Greyfen's quiet verge. There is water here, and no strap to pull him back.
lines: Kael: I wasn't ready to promise you a road. I haven't forgotten you.
Bracken stands, waiting to see whether this visit will be different.

actions.label: There's room beside me, Bracken.

variants.greeting: The loose strap drops into the grass. The hound could leave, but takes a careful step toward Kael instead.
lines: Kael: Bracken. A better name than whatever they scratched off that harness.
Kael: The road isn't kind. Neither is being left on it. You needn't decide as quickly as I do.

actions.label: You can make a home with me.
Stay safe in Greyfen for now. I'll remember where you are.

variants.greeting: His breathing slows. The harness strap, not his leg, is caught beneath a root.
lines: Kael: Just the buckle. Keep still. Then the choice is yours.

actions.label: Unfasten the snagged strap.

notice_board.name: Greyfen Notice Board
notice_board.greeting: Three missing on the north road. Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Her son Oren.
lines: Payment for an account of the missing and proof of what took them. Names held at the Crow Shrine.
A second hand has added: Bram did not abandon a cart while someone needed it. Ask who closed the road.

variants.greeting: The order beside the contract has been crossed through. The names remain.
lines: Kael: The grain is no longer being held against a signature. Keeping it moving will take more than words.

variants.greeting: A Vargan notice covers half the old contract.
lines: Protected households must attend the renewal. Grain allotments will be recorded beside their assent.
Kael: Hunger does not make an oath freely given.

variants.greeting: Oren's token hangs below the contract. Someone has tied a dry scrap of cloth over it.
lines: Kael: They have not taken it down. Somebody is afraid enough to cover it and kind enough to keep it dry.

variants.greeting: A small note has been added: anyone who saw Bram's cart should speak to Anwen.
lines: Kael: A private account can still invite a second witness.

variants.greeting: The payment remains unclaimed. Beneath it, three empty places for names.
lines: Kael: Keeping the token is not the same as keeping them safe.

actions.label: I will find what happened to Bram, Sella, and Oren.

sister_anwen.name: Sister Anwen
sister_anwen.greeting: Mind the cup on the step. The man from the south road needs it more than I need a clean floor.
lines: Kael: I read the road notice. Three missing.
Anwen: Bram drove. Sella had Oren beside her. He left his coat here because the sun was out.
Anwen: They found old wooden tokens where the road was being repaired. Sella asked me to read one. I did.
Kael: What happened when you read it?
Anwen: The candles went out. I sent them away while I found a rite I thought would keep them safe.
Anwen: If you find red thread around black feathers, keep it intact. I tied it. I owe you that much before you go.

variants.greeting: Thank you for the water. Now, the three who have not come home.
I have put the grain list beside the burial book. No one has to sign one to receive the other.
lines: Anwen: I could call that a beginning. It is mostly a table and two people willing to sit at it.
Kael: Beginnings usually look smaller when somebody is doing the work.

variants.greeting: I will give you the register. I am not agreeing to stand in a rite you threatened me into.
lines: Kael: The record can speak to facts. It cannot make your promise for you.
Anwen: Then you do understand the difference.

variants.greeting: Edric wants my hand on the new seal. He has already counted the households that cannot afford to refuse.
lines: Anwen: The old rite borrowed consent from frightened people. That is why it keeps breaking.
Kael: Can the Hart be released without making everyone here swear?
Anwen: Yes. Someone must freely keep the recovered account. One person can begin. More people can share the work.

variants.greeting: Three strokes. A burial, a restored name, and a promise that has stopped holding.
lines: Anwen: I cut the rope last winter. A novice heard an erased name and walked into the sealed chapel. I found him too late.
Kael: You closed it again.
Anwen: Yes. I told myself I was buying time. The graves will show what that time cost.

actions.label: I'll stay until the people carrying this can speak safely.
actions.result: Kael: I cannot promise nobody gets hurt. I can promise I will not take the coin and leave you to it.

actions.label: I'll stay. We keep a record nobody can close again.
actions.result: Kael: Copies, names, living witnesses. Not another secret that depends on one person.

actions.label: I'll stay, but you tell me what you are asking me to carry.
actions.result: Anwen: That is fair. I should have asked before I put the token in your hand.

variants.greeting: That is Oren's carving. Turn it over. The older name is beneath his paint.
lines: Kael: You sent them out carrying something the shrine had erased.
Anwen: I thought new burial thread would quiet it. Someone bound it again with Vargan wire.
Kael: The pack is dead. The people hiding this are alive.
Anwen: Take your payment if you must. I need help I have no right to order.

actions.label: I'll stay until the people carrying this can speak safely.
actions.result: Kael: I cannot promise nobody gets hurt. I can promise I will not take the coin and leave you to it.

actions.label: I'll stay, but you tell me what you are asking me to carry.
actions.result: Anwen: That is fair. I should have asked before I put the token in your hand.

variants.greeting: I saw the token on the board. Rook has moved his bedding from the window.
lines: Kael: People needed to know what was on their road.
Anwen: Yes. And the people who can explain it need a way to survive being known.
Kael: Then we do both. I will not leave the second part to a notice.

actions.label: I'll stay until the people carrying this can speak safely.
actions.result: Kael: I cannot promise nobody gets hurt. I can promise I will not take the coin and leave you to it.

actions.label: I'll stay, but you tell me what you are asking me to carry.
actions.result: Anwen: That is fair. I should have asked before I put the token in your hand.

variants.greeting: Keep your hand closed if you need to. I recognize the shape through your glove.
lines: Anwen: Oren painted over a refugee's token. Sella wanted the first name restored.
Kael: Someone alive tried to take it from the pack.
Anwen: Then leaving now would leave a witness carrying something dangerous. I am asking you to stay.

actions.label: I'll stay until the people carrying this can speak safely.
actions.result: Kael: I cannot promise nobody gets hurt. I can promise I will not take the coin and leave you to it.

actions.result: Anwen: That is fair. I should have asked before I put the token in your hand.

actions.label: I'll bring back evidence.
actions.result: Anwen nods once. 'Then bring back what the road tried to hide.'
actions.preview: Anwen nods once. 'Then bring back what the road tried to hide.'
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: You can explain when I return.
actions.result: Kael leaves the silence between them intact. Anwen looks relieved, then ashamed of it.
actions.preview: Kael leaves the silence between them intact. Anwen looks relieved, then ashamed of it.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: If the shrine is involved, I report it.
actions.result: Anwen's hand tightens around the prayer cord. 'Then do not let fear choose the wording.'
actions.preview: Anwen's hand tightens around the prayer cord. 'Then do not let fear choose the wording.'
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: I will follow the cart. Keep his coat here.
Will you speak for your own part, without the seal?
actions.result: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Anwen.
actions.preview: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Anwen.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Give me the book. I will not demand your oath.
actions.result: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Anwen.
actions.preview: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Anwen.

mira.name: Mira Fen
mira.greeting: Hold the door. Elna is bringing broth, and I have both hands occupied.
lines: Mira: Toma's daughter has a fever. The draught works. The roots it needs grow in the old ash beds.
Kael: Does Toma know where it comes from?
Mira: He knows I can bring the fever down. I have let him think that was the only fact that mattered.
Mira: Sella bought salve for Oren's hands. Too much carving. I have one jar she never collected.

variants.greeting: The clean roots take longer to steep. I keep a cold cloth ready between doses.
lines: Mira: You did not make the fever disappear by closing the ash bed.
Kael: No. Who needs help while the new treatment catches up?
Mira: Toma. He has not slept. Bring him the broth before it cools.

variants.greeting: The jars have their source written on them now. Two families refused. Three asked questions.
lines: Mira: I treated all five. Consent would mean little if refusal meant I stopped caring.
Kael: What will you say at the assembly?
Mira: What I used. What I withheld. What I am changing.

variants.greeting: The fever broke. Toma thanked me. I let him.
lines: Mira: There is your immediate result. A child is breathing easier.
Kael: And the part he still cannot choose?
Mira: Still here. Under the label I have not written.

variants.greeting: The wrapped core shifts toward the names in the book, not toward my instruments.
lines: Mira: It is a memory, not a patient who can answer me. I will not call a useful response permission.
Kael: Study what is already exposed. Do not open another name without asking the family.

variants.greeting: Say Oren's name at the old stones. Watch the roots before you move closer.
lines: Mira: The oil shows where the memory is caught. It does not decide what you should do with it.
Kael: And breaking the vessel?
Mira: Stops that shape. The memory goes somewhere else. We can defend ourselves without pretending the aftermath is nothing.

variants.greeting: The chapel register and the roots turned toward the same name.
lines: Mira: Oren restored a name on his token. The road's concealment could not keep it disordered afterward.
Kael: That brought the creatures?
Mira: The tokens drew them. The failed binding left the memory loose. Read the register before you face what took it.

actions.label: I will read the chapel register.
Give me what Moon Oil needs.
Show me what the fever draught needs.
I brought the roots from the marked bed.
Keep treating quietly until there is an alternative.
actions.result: Mira keeps the ash bed open. The fever falls, but families cannot choose a treatment whose origin remains hidden.
actions.preview: Mira keeps the ash bed open. The fever falls, but families cannot choose a treatment whose origin remains hidden.
actions.cost: Alternative treatment is slower. Continued ash use needs families who can freely refuse it.

actions.label: Explain the source. Offer each family another treatment.
actions.result: Mira labels the ash draught and sets clean-root doses beside it. The treatment is slower for those who refuse, and care continues. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.
actions.preview: Mira labels the ash draught and sets clean-root doses beside it. The treatment is slower for those who refuse, and care continues. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.
actions.cost: Alternative treatment is slower. Continued ash use needs families who can freely refuse it.

actions.label: Use the miller's measure to treat the sick.
actions.result: Mira keeps the figures beside the names of those the ash harmed.
actions.preview: Mira keeps the figures beside the names of those the ash harmed.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Close the ash bed. Use clean roots and accept the delay.
actions.result: Mira closes the old bed and prepares clean roots. Toma stays through the slower treatment; nobody calls the extra waiting harmless. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.
actions.preview: Mira closes the old bed and prepares clean roots. Toma stays through the slower treatment; nobody calls the extra waiting harmless. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.

actions.label: Will you freely speak to your own use of the ash?
actions.result: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Mira.
actions.preview: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Mira.

actions.label: Give me your written findings. I will not ask you for an oath.
actions.result: The decision is recorded. Nobody else can make it for Mira.

edric.name: Lord Edric Vargan
edric.greeting: The south granary is open. Tell the guard the sick household goes first.
lines: Kael: Your seal was wrapped around a child's token.
Edric: My men were sent to contain a breach. They came back with empty hands and fewer men.
Edric: I have grain for Greyfen. I do not have a road that will carry it safely.
Kael: And the people who know why?
Edric: Bring their account to the castle. I will show you what another winter requires.

actions.label: I will bring the road evidence to your record hall.
Your gate is open. Now show me the records.

variants.greeting: The carts will move without a household seal. I have given the order.
lines: Edric: My guards can keep a road open. They cannot make the people on it believe me.
Kael: Begin with the first job. The second takes longer.

variants.greeting: You have read the renewal order. You have not watched a hungry house divide its last loaf.
lines: Kael: I have watched people be told safety was inside a gate they could not enter.
Edric: Then come to the record hall. Argue where the figures are.

rook.name: Rook
rook.greeting: You got the cart moving? Good. I was about to sell him a very expensive push.
lines: Rook: Bram fixed my axle twice. Charged me once. Claimed he could not afford to be seen with a grateful smuggler.
Kael: You knew the other two?
Rook: Sella asked about the old road. Oren asked whether the crows paid me to follow them.
Rook: The road bends where the old waystone says it should not. I have a map. I also have a room somebody can find.

actions.label: Ask what he carried.
Copy the route. Keep the families' homes private.
actions.result: Rook marks a usable road without family addresses. He agrees to speak to the route under protection.
actions.preview: Rook marks a usable road without family addresses. He agrees to speak to the route under protection.
actions.cost: A public route can endanger marked families; a destroyed map cannot help the next traveler.

actions.label: Destroy the map. Keep the route between us.
actions.result: The paper burns. The road remains in Rook's memory, but no stranger can follow a copy now.
actions.preview: The paper burns. The road remains in Rook's memory, but no stranger can follow a copy now.
actions.cost: A public route can endanger marked families; a destroyed map cannot help the next traveler.

actions.label: Publish the marked map so everyone can challenge Vargan.
actions.result: The route becomes public evidence. Rook takes his bedding from the window; he did not consent to exposing his family.
actions.preview: The route becomes public evidence. Rook takes his bedding from the window; he did not consent to exposing his family.
actions.cost: A public route can endanger marked families; a destroyed map cannot help the next traveler.

variants.greeting: They copied the map with my family mark still on it. A guard came to my door.
lines: Rook: You needed a witness. You got a target as well.
Kael: I will keep a way out open.
Rook: That was meant to be the promise before you put my name up.

variants.greeting: I copied the route without the houses. The families know who has the original.
lines: Rook: I will tell the assembly what I saw. They do not need my grandmother's bedroom to believe it.
Kael: You choose what is yours to share.
Rook: There. A sentence I could get used to.

variants.greeting: I can still walk the route. I will not make another map for you.
lines: Rook: Destroying the copy kept Vargan from using it. It kept the next refugee from using it too.
Kael: I can carry the route in the record without your family mark.
Rook: Then learn it properly.

variants.greeting: The guard asked where my grandmother lived. Said he was checking who deserved protection.
lines: Rook: My family kept names because the shrine would not. That does not make us willing to be nailed to a board.
Kael: I promised to stay with the people carrying this.
Rook: Then stay where they can reach you. The false waystone is a good start.

widow_elna.name: Widow Elna
widow_elna.greeting: Harl used to warm my shoes by the fire. Burned one once. Hid it for a week.
lines: Elna: You can know that and still hear what I ask next.
Elna: His grave bell rings with the rope cut. He helped close Greyfen's gate in the war. I told our children he held it for their safety.
Kael: Did he ever speak about the people outside?
Elna: He would stop setting the table when it rained. Find what he left. Do not decide for me that love makes me unable to hear it.

actions.label: I will hear what the bell is carrying.
I found Harl's bell.
Give Elna the whole account, and let her decide to speak.
actions.result: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.
actions.preview: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.
actions.cost: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

actions.label: Offer the gentler account. Leave the evidence with her.
actions.result: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.
actions.preview: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.
actions.cost: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

actions.label: Tell her everything privately. Keep her grief out of the square.
actions.result: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.
actions.preview: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.
actions.cost: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

variants.greeting: I told the children he loved us. Then I told them who stood outside the gate.
lines: Elna: My daughter asked if both were true. I said yes.
Kael: Will you speak at the assembly?
Elna: About what I know. His victims do not need me performing my grief over their names.

variants.greeting: I put the bell in the drawer. It is quieter in there.
lines: Elna: You offered me a gentler account. I heard what you left out.
Kael: The record remains.
Elna: Then leave it where the children can find it when they ask.

variants.greeting: The children have the account. I will not read it in the square.
lines: Elna: You may name what Harl did. You may not use my kitchen as proof I have forgiven it.
Kael: Your grief stays yours.

blacksmith_tor.name: Blacksmith Tor
blacksmith_tor.greeting: Keep the scrap. I can spare a hinge more easily than another cart stuck outside.
lines: Tor: The forge still runs. If the road goes, every household will want a latch before they want a sword.
Kael: There are letters ground off this iron.
Tor: Refugee marks. I recognized them years ago. Told myself metal did not care who used it next.
Tor: Some of it is holding doors shut against the rain. You want it back, tell me what we put in its place.

actions.label: Take scrap iron.
Show me the marks that survived grinding.
I recovered iron from the chapel.
Replace the useful iron gradually. Make named memorial work.
actions.result: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.
actions.preview: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

actions.label: Keep the tools in use. Disclose their source and fund replacement.
actions.result: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.
actions.preview: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

actions.label: Surrender the marked stock. Let the families decide its use.
actions.result: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.
actions.preview: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

variants.greeting: The new nails carry the names where a hammer will not strike them away.
lines: Tor: I am replacing one working piece at a time. Elna still has a door while I make the marker.
Kael: What did it cost?
Tor: Two contracts. A late night. Less than grinding those letters off cost somebody else.

variants.greeting: The refugee marks face outward now. Nobody buys this stock without being told.
lines: Tor: The tools stay useful. A share of each sale goes to replacement iron and the road record.
Kael: You will say that publicly?
Tor: I already wrote it above the price.

variants.greeting: The marked stock is on the table, with the forge accounts beside it.
lines: Tor: Anwen will keep it until the families decide. I work from new scrap now.
Kael: Is the forge closing?
Tor: Not if you stop talking and help carry the clean iron.

farmer_toma.name: Farmer Toma
farmer_toma.greeting: She is asleep. Speak low. Mira finally got the fever down.
lines: Toma: My daughter was outside when the bandits came. The thing at the fold put itself between her and a blade.
Kael: And the missing sheep?
Toma: I fed it. Then I hid it. It started taking from the next field and I kept telling myself gratitude was different from a danger.
Toma: Read the boot marks with the tracks. I want the whole cause found, even the part that is mine.

actions.label: I will compare the tracks and the bandits' camp.
Move its protection path beyond the farms. Warn the neighbors.
actions.result: Toma marks the outer boundary and moves the feeding place. The guardian survives beyond the fields; its danger is acknowledged.
actions.preview: Toma marks the outer boundary and moves the feeding place. The guardian survives beyond the fields; its danger is acknowledged.
actions.cost: Protection carries danger; ending the fragment loses the guard it offered.

actions.label: Keep it at the fold under a disclosed village watch.
actions.result: Toma tells the neighbors and organizes a watch. Protection remains, but the village can withdraw its agreement.
actions.preview: Toma tells the neighbors and organizes a watch. Protection remains, but the village can withdraw its agreement.
actions.cost: Protection carries danger; ending the fragment loses the guard it offered.

actions.label: Show the farmer what the mill weighed.
actions.result: Toma stops spreading the ash and warns the other farms.
actions.preview: Toma stops spreading the ash and warns the other farms.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: End the dangerous guardian. Record why it protected her.
actions.result: The protection fragment is put to rest. Toma names the people it saved and the livestock his secrecy cost.
actions.preview: The protection fragment is put to rest. Toma names the people it saved and the livestock his secrecy cost.
actions.cost: Protection carries danger; ending the fragment loses the guard it offered.

variants.greeting: The outer boundary is marked. My daughter knows the posts mean stop.
lines: Toma: The creature follows the old protection path beyond the fields. I warned the neighbors this time.
Kael: A boundary only works if everyone knows where it is.

variants.greeting: There is a watch at the fold and a warning on every gate.
lines: Toma: I do not call it harmless. I call the neighbors before I feed it.
Kael: They get to change their minds.
Toma: Yes. Even when I wish they would not.

variants.greeting: The fold is quiet. She keeps asking why the thing that protected her had to die.
lines: Toma: I told her about the sheep. And that I hid it until there were no easy choices left.
Kael: Keep its protection in the account too.

variants.greeting: The neighbors stopped asking. That is not the same as the danger ending.
lines: Toma: I heard it at the next field last night. I will not tell you I was surprised.

returned_soldier.name: The Returned Soldier
returned_soldier.greeting: Hold the gate. Hold the gate. The lantern is on the wrong side.
lines: Kael: You are repeating one night. Can you tell me your name?
The Returned Soldier: Len. Mother left the lantern. Hold the gate.
Kael: A fragment caught in an empty grave. Not a man who knows what happened afterward.
The Returned Soldier: Len. The lantern is on the wrong side.

actions.label: Record Len's name. Let the repeated watch end.
actions.result: The lantern memory goes still. Len's name is entered beside the gate account; the fragment offers no new oath.
actions.preview: The lantern memory goes still. Len's name is entered beside the gate account; the fragment offers no new oath.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Settle the fragment privately. Preserve the name in the book.
actions.result: The grave settles. Len's name remains in the recovered record without a public spectacle.
actions.preview: The grave settles. Len's name remains in the recovered record without a public spectacle.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

white_hart.name: The White Hart
white_hart.greeting: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.
lines: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.
The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.
Kael: You have carried what they tried to bury. You should not have to carry what we do next.
The White Hart: Then let your next act belong to you. Not to fear of my antlers. Not to another hunger at the gate.
Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.
The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.
The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.
The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.
Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.
The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

actions.label: Witness — make the account public; stay to preserve it.
actions.preview: Release the Hart through public acknowledgment and Kael's willing work to preserve the record.
actions.cost: Lost privilege, trade pressure, and the ongoing labor of restitution. Fewer allies mean more work for Kael.

actions.label: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.
actions.preview: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.
actions.cost: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.

actions.label: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.
actions.preview: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.
actions.cost: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.

actions.label: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.
actions.preview: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.
actions.cost: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.
